test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that is closest in meaning to the underlined idiom/phrase in the given sentence.

Please __cut down on__ your expenses now or you will face difficulties in the future.
solution:
The correct answer is **reduce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Cut down:** to reduce the size, amount, or number of something.

 
 
• **Example: **I
